hook_en: Pour out your heart to Him. 🙏
reflect_en: David invites all of us to trust God at all times and to pour out our hearts before Him, because God is our refuge. As this week winds down, you don't have to tidy up your prayers first; bring Him everything you've been holding.
q_en: What do you need to pour out before God this weekend?
x_en: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge.

yt_title: Pour Out Your Hearts Before Him | Psalm 62:7–8 #Shorts
yt_line: Pour out your heart to Him today.
li_open: Healthy teams are places where people can be honest.
li_quote: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge.
li_body: David didn't tell God's people to hide their burdens; he told them to pour out their hearts before Him. Leaders who make room for honest prayer, and faithfully pray for what their people share, help their communities rest on God as their refuge instead of carrying everything alone.
hook_es: Derrama tu corazón delante de Él. 🙏
reflect_es: David nos invita a esperar en Dios en todo tiempo y a derramar delante de Él nuestro corazón, porque Dios es nuestro amparo. Al terminar la semana, no necesitas tener tus oraciones en orden: tráele todo lo que has estado cargando.
q_es: ¿Qué necesitas derramar delante de Dios este fin de semana?
x_es: Esperad en él en todo tiempo, oh pueblos; derramad delante de él vuestro corazón: Dios es nuestro amparo.
